notes: Install only the A2Z v4 15-minute template timer file and daemon-reload. Do not enable or start any timer/service in this task.

[Unit]
Description=Prediction A2Z v4 model retry timer for %i

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:0/15
Persistent=true
Unit=prediction-a2z-v4-model@%i.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

from pathlib import Path
p=Path("control/codex_supervisor/systemd/prediction-a2z-v4-model@.timer")
t=p.read_text()
assert "OnCalendar=*:0/15" in t
assert "Persistent=true" in t
assert "Unit=prediction-a2z-v4-model@%i.service" in t
assert "WantedBy=timers.target" in t
